description: BISMARCK – Today, Julie Fedorchak announced she has received an endorsement from a member of the Republican’s House Leadership team, Conference Chairwoman, Elise Stefanik. “I’m proud to endorse Julie Fedorchak for North Dakota’s at-large congressional seat. We need strong Members of Congress who are committed to fighting for President Trump’s America First agenda who deliver results. […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Fedorchak for ND
title: House Republican Conference Chairwoman Elise Stefanik Endorses Julie Fedorchak - Julie Fedorchak
